mapper.select: /* oasYaml.selSpcForOas */ SELECT s.api_spc_no AS "apiSpcNo" ,s.api_nm AS "apiNm" ,COALESCE(s.api_desc, '') AS "apiDesc" ,s.ver AS "ver" ,s.host AS "host" ,s.bas_path AS "basPath" ,s.sys_id AS "sysId" ,COALESCE(s.spc_src_cd, 'LEGACY') AS "spcSrcCd" FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC s WHERE s.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer AND s.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* oasYaml.selCtgryListForOas */ SELECT c.api_ctgry_no AS "apiCtgryNo" ,c.ctgry_nm AS "ctgryNm" ,COALESCE(c.ctgry_desc,'') AS "ctgryDesc" FROM KOA_TB_API_CTGRY c WHERE c.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer AND c.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY c.SORT_ODRG, c.API_CTGRY_NO

/* oasYaml.selDefListForOas */ SELECT d.api_no AS "apiNo" ,d.api_nm AS "apiNm" ,COALESCE(d.api_desc, '') AS "apiDesc" ,d.api_path AS "apiPath" ,LOWER(COALESCE(m.cd_nm, '')) AS "methodNm" ,COALESCE(d.api_id, '') AS "apiId" ,COALESCE(d.api_ver, '') AS "apiVer" ,COALESCE(c.ctgry_nm, '') AS "ctgryNm" ,COALESCE(d.use_yn, 'Y') AS "useYn" FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF d LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_CTGRY c ON c.API_CTGRY_NO = d.API_CTGRY_NO LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD m ON m.COMN_CD = d.METHOD_CD AND m.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000' WHERE d.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer ORDER BY c.SORT_ODRG, d.SORT_ODRG, d.API_NO

/* oasYaml.selParamListForOas */ SELECT p.api_no AS "apiNo" ,p.param_no AS "paramNo" ,p.prnts_param_no AS "prntsParamNo" ,p.param_nm AS "paramNm" ,p.data_type_cd AS "dataTypeCd" ,p.param_type_cd AS "paramTypeCd" ,COALESCE(p.param_loc, '') AS "paramLoc" ,COALESCE(p.required, 'N') AS "required" ,COALESCE(p.param_desc,'') AS "paramDesc" ,COALESCE(p.exam, '') AS "exam" ,COALESCE(p.personal_data, '') AS "personalData" ,COALESCE(p.res_cd, '') AS "resCd" ,COALESCE(p.res_desc, '') AS "resDesc" ,COALESCE(p.obj_odrg, 0) AS "objOdrg" ,COALESCE(p.sort_odrg, 0) AS "sortOdrg" FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM p INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF d ON d.API_NO = p.API_NO WHERE d.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer ORDER BY p.API_NO, p.OBJ_ODRG, p.SORT_ODRG, p.PARAM_NO
/* oasYaml.selSpcNoListForRegen */ SELECT s.API_SPC_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC s WHERE s.DEL_YN = 'N' AND s.SPC_SRC_CD = 'SPCREG' ORDER BY s.API_SPC_NO
